original: I thought maybe we should get some\nfood.
I'm stuck using a twig for bait.\nI'm hoping fish will mistake it\nfor a worm.
This is why I *said* I didn't want\nto go to camp.
You can tell me that all you want,\nbut I can't do much about it.
Who else do I say it to, then?\nWe're the only ones here!
Yeah, but if we're gonna drift\naround, we should have a bit more\noptimism about it.
How are we supposed to have a bit\nmore optimism?!\n...Ah...ughhhh...
Can't really call this\nseasickness. Maybe bedsickness?
What does seasickness have to do\nwith optimism...Hm? A box!
Maybe it's got something to eat!\nLike canned food, or rations.
Sorry, I'm not food! I'm gonna\nbeat you, Chosen Children!
We can't run away! All this bed\nshaking is making me sick!
Attacking at a time like this?\nYou're playing dirty!
Shut up! Take this!\nFist of the Tyrant!
We managed to get away...and when\nI thought it was all over, your\nfishing line appeared.
We didn't catch any fish, but I'm\nglad it worked out.
So, I have a favor to ask.
It's about Jou. He's completely\nlost his nerve.
We can't have an adventure like\nthis, so let's make him leader to\ngive him some confidence.
That's why we're making you leader\nfrom now on!
You're the only one who can do it,\nJou!
Is that to celebrate me becoming\nleader?
Maybe this time there'll be humans\ninside!
Wait! Jou is the leader! What\nshould we do, Leader?
Okay! Maybe we'll finally see\nother humans in that church!
You're still saying that. It'd be\nconvenient if there were, but...
He's become more of a leader!
Excuse me, what kind of dance is\nthis?
This is a carnival where we make\nofferings to the Great Bakemon!
The Great Bakemon is the Great\nBakemon!
Would you also like to leave\nofferings to the Great Bakemon?
I know about Bakemon! They're\nghost Digimon who live in the\nOverdell Graveyard, but...
...They're not exactly a Digimon\nyou'd want to leave offerings to.
God does not tolerate those who\nspeak ill of the Great Bakemon!
We are lucky to have guests come\non our day of carnival.
We're lucky to have ended up on\nthis island!
Jou, there's something really\nsuspicious about these people.
Have any other children besides us\ncome here?
I see. I wonder where everyone\nelse is...
More importantly, want to come\ndance for the Great Bakemon with\nus?
We've come from Tokyo, and we need\nto get back.
That seems like a problem. Please\ndo stay in this church as long as\nyou like.
No, I mean we *want* to get back!
Looks like we're not going to get\nanywhere...
Luckily, we have obtained our\nofferings for today.
Where's the offering? I can't see\nit.
Good, you're up. I was worried...
Where are we? Where are Jou and\nGomamon?
I think they're probably in\nanother jail cell in the basement.
We've got to find a way to get out\nof here and meet up with Jou and\nGomamon...
I feel a bit of air. I think\nthere's a gap in the wall\nsomewhere around here.
The floor, ceiling, and walls all\nlook kind of unstable.
There's a hole! It's small, but it\nlooks like we can squeeze through.
Looks like it's a bit too small\nfor me.
All right. In that case, you wait\nhere and I'll open the door from\nthe outside!
Okay, but be careful! There are\nBakemon guards outside keeping\nwatch.
Thanks! I'll make it back for\nsure.
Sorry, it looks like they found\nme...
Stop trying to escape. Sit down\nand be quiet like good offerings!
Looks like they haven't noticed\nthe hole in the cell...
I plugged it after you went out!\nThey didn't notice it at all.
All right, I'm gonna try again.
Yeah, I'll do it this time!
(They're keeping a close watch.\nDoesn't seem like I can get\nthrough there...)
Hey, you look kind of pale.
Can't you see I haven't been\nsleeping well lately?
(Looks like I can't get through\nwithout Piyomon...)
I really should have studied at\nhome instead of going to camp...
You're making too much noise! Be\nquiet.
(Jou's safe...but I can't defeat\nthose guards without getting\nPiyomon out.)
Thanks, Sora! Let's hurry up and\nget out of here.
We have to get Jou and Gomamon out\nfirst!
It won't be so easy to catch us\nthis time!
If we go out this way, we'll be\nable to escape.
We have to get Jou and Gomamon out\nfirst!
Right...let's find out where the\nBakemon are holding them!
Sora! We can't abandon Jou and\nGomamon!
L-let go of me! If you eat me,\nI'll taste bad! Let go!
That's not a problem, what we need\nis your soul!
Are you saying someone else has a\nbetter-tasting soul?
Jou, is this how a leader should\nact? You over there, let go\nof them!
Idiots! All you've done is save us\ntime taking you out of the prison!
You're a hundred years too early\nto make me your offering!
My luck is terrible, I didn't\nthink that going to camp would\nmake all this happen...
Pull yourself together, Jou!\nYou're the leader right now!
Let's run for it before they find\nus!
?! But the prison had guards\nposted in front!
W-we did it, now let's get out of\nhere!
It'll be easy from now on! Easy!
It'll be easy from now on! Easy!
We should hurry, before they catch\nus!
What do we do, Sora? We're\nsurrounded!
You've made a big mistake in\nthinking you could escape. Your\nsouls will be delicious!
The best souls are prepared by\nscaring them thoroughly!
They fused into a giant one!
They fused into a giant one!
It's a ghost, so attacks don't\nwork!
It's a ghost, so attacks don't\nwork!
A ghost...the only thing that'll\nwork is a sutra asking for God's\ndivine grace!
My grandma from the country gave\nme one so I could do well on\ntests.
Gnis selb taergst niop llufst niop\nderd nuh...
Gnis selb taergst niop llufst niop\nderd nuh...
Okay, now! Gomamon, Piyomon! It's\nyour turn!
Okay, now! Gomamon, Piyomon! It's\nyour turn!
I don't know how we did it, but we\nwon!
Maybe everyone else made it back\nthere!
(I can't get caught by the guards,\nI have to get Piyomon out of the\nprison...)
